title: bamboo spoon
text: bamboo spoon. I purchased this to try the saying that if you sit one over a pot it won't boil over.  Tried it.  It seems to work.  But that aside, this is literally a terrific wooden spoon.  I love it.  The bowl is the perfect size. It's light weight but very sturdy.  I'm very happy with the purchase.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
